fee_notes: Single $50,000 Initial Franchise Fee. Veterans (honorably discharged, 20%+ ownership) receive 10% discount. Multi-Unit Operator Development Rights Fee (no additional franchise fee): 2 centers=$75,000, 3=$95,000, 4=$110,000, 5=$125,000. Center Development Fee $40,000 (separate). Training Fee $40,000 (separate). Background checks $1,000-$2,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay our standard initial franchise fee of $50,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is payable when you sign the franchise agreement.
